note: 皺枯れる writes 皺 (しわ) before 枯れる, so it is しわがれる or its contraction しゃがれる; かれる has nothing for 皺 and belongs to 嗄れる.
そのた is その with 他 read た; 外 has no reading た, and その外 is そのほか. Daijisen lists そのた only as 其の他. A restriction was proposed to JMdict on 2026-11-27 (revision 2383857).
そのた is the reading of その他 (他 read た); 外 has no reading た and 其の外 is read そのほか. Kotobank lists その‐ほか【其外・其他】 but gives 外 no た reading.
あくけい is the game term 悪形, a bad shape, with 形 read けい; 方 has no reading けい, and 悪方 is the kabuki role あくがた. A restriction was proposed to JMdict on 2026-11-27 (revision 2383868).
意久地 is a phonetic spelling of the changed form いくじ, with 久 standing for く; 久 has no reading き, so いきじ belongs only to 意気地/意氣地.
いこうどうおん reads the 口 of 異口同音 as こう; 異句同音 is the miswriting that arises from いくどうおん, and 句 is read く, not こう.
うな丼 writes only うな in kana, so nothing in it accounts for the ぎ of うなぎどん; that reading belongs to the spellings that write 鰻 or うなぎ.
彼 is か, so 何だ彼だ is なんだかだ (Kotobank lists it under that reading); なんだかんだ needs the ん that 何だ彼んだ writes in kana.
てき is the on reading of 敵; 仇 is キュウ, あだ or かたき, so 仇同士 is かたきどうし. Nihon Kokugo Daijiten gives てきどうし as a variant under 敵同士 only. A restriction was proposed to JMdict on 2026-11-27 (revision 2383873).
ちょ is the customary reading of 緒, so たんちょ belongs to 端緒 (Nihon Kokugo Daijiten: 「ちょ」は「緒」の慣用音). 初 is only しょ, so 端初 can only be たんしょ.
合 is あい and has no reading ま; まくま comes from reading the 間 of 幕間 as ま, so it cannot belong to 幕合.
きぬつむぎ is a kun reading of 絹紬 (絹 is きぬ); 繭 is まゆ or けん, never きぬ, and Kotobank lists きぬ‐つむぎ only as 【絹紬】 while 繭紬 appears only under けんちゅう.
むかか is the on reading of 無花果 (無 む, 花 か, 果 か); 映 is えい and 日 is じつ, and 映日果 read by its characters is えいじつか.
にょう is the go-on reading of 饒 and not a reading of 冗; Nihon Kokugo Daijiten lists にょうぜつ only as 饒舌. A restriction was proposed to JMdict on 2026-11-27 (revision 2383870).
じょうしん is the reading of 上唇; nothing in it accounts for 口, which 上口唇 writes for the くち of うわくちびる.

ごとう is the on reading of 梧桐 (梧 ご + 桐 とう); 青 has no reading ご, and 青桐 is あおぎり. Daijisen and Nihon Kokugo Daijiten list ごとう only as 梧桐. A restriction was proposed to JMdict on 2026-11-27 (revision 2383859).
あとへはひく contains the particle は (後へは引く), which 後へ引く does not write; the spelling reads only あとへひく.
あとへはひく contains the particle は (後へは退く), which 後へ退く does not write; the spelling reads only あとへひく.
The spelling writes め before 処 (ど), but とどめなく has ど before め, so 処 is left with nothing to read; とどめなく is a transposed form of the word that this spelling cannot spell.
The と of ねとぼけ comes from reading 惚け as とぼけ, as in 寝惚け眼. 寝ぼけまなこ writes ぼけ in kana directly after 寝, and 寝 is not ねと.
お身 writes the prefix in kana as お, which leaves nothing for the ん of おんみ; おんみ belongs to 御身 and おん身.
こっかい is the on reading of 骨灰 (骨 こつ + 灰 かい), the bone-ash fertiliser. 粉 is こ, never こつ; Daijisen and Nihon Kokugo Daijiten give 粉灰 only under こはい and こっぱい.
こつばい is 骨灰 read 骨 こつ + 灰 はい. 粉 is こ, never こつ; Daijisen and Nihon Kokugo Daijiten give 粉灰 only under こはい and こっぱい.
磨き is みがき (磨く is only ever みがく); the unvoiced みかき comes from 身欠き (身 + 欠き), which this spelling does not write.
磨き is みがき (磨く is only ever みがく); the unvoiced みかき comes from 身欠き (身 + 欠き), which this spelling does not write.
磨き is みがき (磨く is only ever みがく); the unvoiced みかき comes from 身欠き (身 + 欠き), which this spelling does not write.

The comma separates 間 (かん) from 髪 (はつ) as two words, which is the かんはつをいれず parsing; ぱつ only arises when 間髪 is run together as one compound, and Daijisen notes the phrase is divided 間、髪を容れず with the かんぱつ grouping being an error.
The reading has the particle を, which だだ捏ねる does not write; this spelling is だだこねる, and 捏 is こ, not をこ.
ロパク is a search aid for typing the kanji 口 (くち) as the look-alike katakana ロ; the kanji 口 is never read ろ, so 口ぱく reads only くちぱく.
ロパク is a search aid for typing the kanji 口 (くち) as the look-alike katakana ロ; the kanji 口 is never read ろ, so 口パク reads only くちパク.
性 is read しょう, giving しょうもない; しようもない is the three-mora し・よ・う of 仕様, which 性 cannot write.

穴 is read けつ in this expression and has no reading しり; しりをまくる belongs to the spellings with 尻. Daijisen heads the phrase 穴(けつ)を捲る. A restriction was proposed to JMdict on 2026-11-27 (revision 2383864).
つばきもも reads 椿 as つばき; 光 has no such reading. Daijisen lists つばきもも only as 椿桃, and gives 光桃 under the changed form つばいもも. A restriction was proposed to JMdict on 2026-11-27 (revision 2383872).
つばきもも reads 椿 as つばき; 油 has no such reading. Daijisen lists つばきもも only as 椿桃, and gives 油桃 under the changed form つばいもも. A restriction was proposed to JMdict on 2026-11-27 (revision 2383872).

ていりょう is the on reading of 庭燎 (燎 りょう); 火 has no reading りょう, and 庭火 is にわび. Daijisen and Nihon Kokugo Daijiten list ていりょう only as 庭燎. A restriction was proposed to JMdict on 2026-11-27 (revision 2383862).
わぐら is 倭 or 和 read わ, plus 鞍; 大和 is やまと, so 大和鞍 is やまとぐら. Daijisen and Nihon Kokugo Daijiten list わぐら only as 和鞍 and 倭鞍. A restriction was proposed to JMdict on 2026-11-27 (revision 2383866).
あんが is the on reading of 鞍瓦 (瓦 が); 橋 has no reading が, and 鞍橋 is くらぼね. Daijisen and Nihon Kokugo Daijiten list あんが only as 鞍瓦. A restriction was proposed to JMdict on 2026-11-27 (revision 2383865).

あんが is the on reading of 鞍瓦 (瓦 が); 骨 has no reading が, and 鞍骨 is くらぼね or あんこつ. Daijisen and Nihon Kokugo Daijiten list あんが only as 鞍瓦. A restriction was proposed to JMdict on 2026-11-27 (revision 2383865).
ちげん is the on reading of 痴言 (痴 ち + 言 げん). 烏滸 is おこ, so 烏滸言 is おこごと.
しゃ is a reading of 藉 and not of 籍, which is only せき; Nihon Kokugo Daijiten lists ちんしゃ only as 枕藉. A restriction was proposed to JMdict on 2026-11-27 (revision 2383869).
包む is つつむ (or くるむ) and has no reading つまむ; キツネに包まれる is the mistaken form きつねにつつまれる, not つままれる, which is written 摘まれる or 抓まれる.
包む is つつむ (or くるむ) and has no reading つまむ; キツネに包まれる is the mistaken form きつねにつつまれる, not つままれる, which is written 摘まれる or 抓まれる.
包む is つつむ (or くるむ) and has no reading つまむ; 狐に包まれる is the mistaken form きつねにつつまれる, not つままれる, which is written 摘まれる or 抓まれる.
包む is つつむ (or くるむ) and has no reading つまむ; 狐に包まれる is the mistaken form きつねにつつまれる, not つままれる, which is written 摘まれる or 抓まれる.
じひろ reads the 火 of 地火炉 as ひ; 下 has no reading ひ. Nihon Kokugo Daijiten lists じひろ only as 地火炉. A restriction was proposed to JMdict on 2026-11-27 (revision 2383871).
かんじ reads the 寺 of 監寺 as じ; 主 has no reading じ. Daijisen and Nihon Kokugo Daijiten list かんじ only as 監寺. A restriction was proposed to JMdict on 2026-11-27 (revision 2383875).
かんじ reads the 寺 of 監寺 as じ; 守 has no reading じ. Daijisen and Nihon Kokugo Daijiten list かんじ only as 監寺. A restriction was proposed to JMdict on 2026-11-27 (revision 2383875).
郎 has no reading はく; かはく belongs to 河伯, and 河郎 is かわろう. Daijisen and Nihon Kokugo Daijiten list かはく only as 河伯. A restriction was proposed to JMdict on 2026-11-27 (revision 2383867).

へい is an on reading of 瓶 and not of 壜, which is ドン, タン or びん. Nihon Kokugo Daijiten gives しゅへい as a variant under 酒瓶 only. The references were sent to JMdict on 2026-11-27 (revision 2383876), but that revision leaves the reading unrestricted, so the restriction has still to be proposed.
のう is the on reading of 嚢 and not a reading of 袋; 香袋 is こうぶくろ. Nihon Kokugo Daijiten lists こうのう only as 香嚢. A restriction was proposed to JMdict on 2026-11-27 (revision 2383877).
おん is a reading of the kanji 御 (御歌); お歌 writes the prefix in kana as お, so it reads おうた and nothing accounts for the ん.
かいにんそう is the on reading of 海人草/海仁草 (海 かい + 人/仁 にん + 草 そう). 鷓鴣菜 is the Chinese herbal name, read しゃこさい on its own, and dictionaries list かいにんそう only under 海人草・海仁草.
キャン飯 writes only キャン before 飯, so it is the clipped form キャンメシ; the プ of キャンプめし is not in the spelling and 飯 is not プめし.
どん屋 writes only どん in kana, so nothing in it accounts for the ぶり of どんぶりや; that reading belongs to 丼屋 and どんぶり屋.
掻い is かい, from 掻く (to scratch); かゆい is 痒い, a different word and character, and 掻 has no reading かゆ.
しょう is a reading of 生 and not of 世; 降世 is こうせい. Nihon Kokugo Daijiten lists こうしょう only as 降生. A restriction was proposed to JMdict on 2026-11-27 (revision 2383878).

しょう is a reading of 生 and not of 世; 降世 is こうせい. Nihon Kokugo Daijiten gives ごうしょう as a variant of こうしょう, which it lists only as 降生. A restriction was proposed to JMdict on 2026-11-27 (revision 2383878).
ピラハ語 writes ピラハ with no ン, so it is ピラハご; ピラハンご belongs to ピラハン語, and 語 is not ンご.
